Autonomic nervous system dysfunction with diagnostic orthostatic tachycardia and impaired circulatory regulation; dyspnea does not establish pulmonary disease.

Spondyloepiphyseal dysplasia; neurologic compromise from odontoid anomalies and cervical instability is a defining manifestation. Respiratory failure is neuromuscular.

Vascular insufficiency defines ischemic disease; the injured target organ varies across subtypes and cannot be assigned across the umbrella.
Loss of previously encoded memories is a neurologic cognitive dysfunction, commonly following brain injury, stroke or seizures.
Inborn lysine-metabolism disorder causing pyridoxine-dependent epilepsy; strabismus reported in 1/2 (50%). Neonatal respiratory distress does not establish intrinsic lung damage.
